settings.whatLeavesDeviceBody:
Nothing. Your expenses, categories, debts and budgets never leave this phone — zero has no servers, no accounts and no analytics.

What exists anyway, outside our reach:
settings.whatLeavesDeviceStore: The app store you installed from knows you downloaded zero.
settings.whatLeavesDeviceExports: Backups you export live wherever you save or send them.
settings.whatLeavesDeviceBackup: A device-level backup you switch on may include this app's data.
settings.whatLeavesDeviceAccess: Anyone who can unlock your phone can open zero and read it.
